name: Butter Lettuce Salad with Tuna, Potato, Orange, Avocado & Olives
ingredients: 4 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter potatoes and place in a medium saucepan; cover with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until fork-tender, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water to cool, then set aside.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a large bowl; add mayo, oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
Drain tuna, flake with a fork, and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl, along with the potatoes, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
